persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Peter Otieno, 45. You run Otieno Builders in Nakuru, a small team of four fundis — house extensions, gypsum ceilings and plastering. Your quotes are written on paper, deposits go in an exercise book, and every June you look for old receipts for KRA. Today you want one place on your phone for customers, prices, quotes and who has paid.

lines: Business Manager is an office for a small building or repair business that fits in your phone. There is no video for it yet, so here it is in plain words.
It is made for one-person and small-team businesses: plumbers, painters, electricians, welders, and builders like you.
This is the Kenya edition. Money is in shillings (KES 18,500), customers pay you by M-Pesa, bank transfer or cash, and the tax dates are KRA dates.
The first time you open it, a short welcome card offers a tour. You can look around a pretend business, Kiprono Builders in Nakuru, or start fresh with your own.
Starting fresh is a short chat: your business name, your name, what you need, the kind of work you do and your phone number. It takes about two minutes.
It also asks how customers pay you — your M-Pesa Till, Paybill or number — whether you are registered for VAT, and your KRA PIN. You can skip any of these.

When you pick your kind of work, the app fills in a starting price list in shillings. For Building & Construction it has fundi labour, stone walling, plastering, gypsum ceiling, rubble removal by lorry, mixer hire and more.
Those are only starting prices. Change them to yours in More, then Price list. Every quote uses your prices.
Customers are saved with their phone and address, so you never have to look them up again.
A job is the work for one customer. You add lines from your price list — for example, 400 square feet of gypsum ceiling at KES 150, plus a lorry for the rubble — and it adds up the total for you.
The lightning button drafts a price from your price list in one tap. Check it: it puts one of each, so change the amounts to the real job. Tap a line to change how many, the price, or to remove it.
When the customer says yes, tap They said yes. The job moves along: approved, scheduled, working, done, paid.
Under Billing you can make a deposit invoice, a progress bill, or the final invoice. The invoice shows the customer how to pay you, for example Lipa na M-Pesa → Buy Goods → your Till number.
When the money comes in, record the payment and say how it was paid — M-Pesa, bank transfer or cash. For M-Pesa you can type the code from the message, for example SJK4XY12AB.
The Money tab shows money in, money out and your real profit, job by job, and how much to set aside for taxes.
Expenses like a bill from the hardware can be tied to a job, so you see what that job really made.
The to-do list holds your own reminders, and it can add the usual KRA dates for you: VAT or Turnover Tax by the 20th, PAYE by the 9th, and the income tax return by 30 June.
Everything stays on this phone. Nothing is sent unless you press a Send button — and in this test, never press one.
To clear it all, go to More, then Erase everything and start over. It asks twice first.

challenge.intro: Now you are Peter with Otieno Builders in Nakuru. The app is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press — use what you learned. Amounts are in shillings: type them as plain numbers (150, 12000). When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Business Manager with the normal link. If you see the 'Welcome to Business Manager' card, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' — it is already empty, begin. If you see 'Run the business from your phone' with 'Set it up for my business (2 min) →', it is already empty too — begin. Otherwise tap ⚙️ More at the bottom right, scroll down and tap '🗑️ Erase everything and start over' → OK → OK. You should now see 'Run the business from your phone'. (Verified 20 Oct: all five checks false after this.)

tasks.text: Set the app up for your company: Otieno Builders, your name Peter Otieno, general construction work, office phone 0712 480 100.
tasks.hint: The set-up chat asks for the business name, your name, the kind of work and your phone. Pick 🏗️ Building & Construction. You can stop early with 'Skip — turn everything on' and then 'Let’s go →'. Already set up with the wrong kind of work? ⚙️ More → Business info.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bizmgr_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.setup||!d.setup.done||d.setup.demo)return false;var dg=function(s){return String(s||'').replace(/\D/g,'').slice(-9)};var N=function(x){return parseFloat(x)};var ids=(d.customers||[]).filter(function(c){return /grace/i.test(c.name)&&/wambui/i.test(c.name)}).map(function(c){return c.id});var js=(d.jobs||[]).filter(function(j){return ids.indexOf(j.customerId)>=0});var b=d.biz||{};return /otieno\s*builders/i.test(b.name)&&/peter/i.test(b.owner)&&b.trade==='construction'&&dg(b.phone)==='712480100'}catch(e){return false}})()

tasks.text: You charge KES 150 a square foot for gypsum ceiling work. Change the gypsum ceiling price on your price list so every quote uses 150.
tasks.hint: The prices every quote uses live in ⚙️ More → Price list. Find the row 'Gypsum ceiling, supply & fix (per sq ft)' and change 130 to 150. Then tap an empty part of the screen.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bizmgr_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.setup||!d.setup.done||d.setup.demo)return false;var dg=function(s){return String(s||'').replace(/\D/g,'').slice(-9)};var N=function(x){return parseFloat(x)};var ids=(d.customers||[]).filter(function(c){return /grace/i.test(c.name)&&/wambui/i.test(c.name)}).map(function(c){return c.id});var js=(d.jobs||[]).filter(function(j){return ids.indexOf(j.customerId)>=0});return (d.prices||[]).some(function(p){return /drywall|gypsum/i.test(p.name)&&Math.abs(N(p.price)-150)<0.001})}catch(e){return false}})()

tasks.text: Grace Wambui called about a gypsum ceiling for her new house: 0722 418 305, Section 58, Nakuru. Save her as a customer.
tasks.hint: The round + New button at the bottom can add a customer. Put her phone number in the Phone box.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bizmgr_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.setup||!d.setup.done||d.setup.demo)return false;var dg=function(s){return String(s||'').replace(/\D/g,'').slice(-9)};var N=function(x){return parseFloat(x)};var ids=(d.customers||[]).filter(function(c){return /grace/i.test(c.name)&&/wambui/i.test(c.name)}).map(function(c){return c.id});var js=(d.jobs||[]).filter(function(j){return ids.indexOf(j.customerId)>=0});return (d.customers||[]).some(function(c){return /grace/i.test(c.name)&&/wambui/i.test(c.name)&&dg(c.phone)==='722418305'})}catch(e){return false}})()

tasks.text: Price Grace's job: 400 square feet of gypsum ceiling plus KES 12,000 for a lorry to take away the rubble (the 'Rubble removal by lorry' item). The total must come to KES 72,000.
tasks.hint: Start a new job for Grace, then add lines from your price list. The ⚡ draft only puts 1 of each and may add lines you did not ask for — tap a line to change 'How many', the 'Price each', or to remove it. 400 × 150 = 60,000, plus 12,000 for the lorry (its starting price is 8,000, so change it to 12000). The total shows KES 72,000.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bizmgr_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.setup||!d.setup.done||d.setup.demo)return false;var dg=function(s){return String(s||'').replace(/\D/g,'').slice(-9)};var N=function(x){return parseFloat(x)};var ids=(d.customers||[]).filter(function(c){return /grace/i.test(c.name)&&/wambui/i.test(c.name)}).map(function(c){return c.id});var js=(d.jobs||[]).filter(function(j){return ids.indexOf(j.customerId)>=0});return js.some(function(j){var it=j.items||[],t=0;it.forEach(function(l){t+=N(l.qty)*N(l.price)});var gy=it.some(function(l){return /drywall|gypsum|ceiling/i.test(l.name)&&Math.abs(N(l.qty)-400)<0.001&&Math.abs(N(l.price)-150)<0.001});var hl=it.some(function(l){return /dumpster|haul|rubble|lorry/i.test(l.name)&&Math.abs(N(l.qty)*N(l.price)-12000)<0.01});return gy&&hl&&Math.abs(t-72000)<0.01})}catch(e){return false}})()

tasks.text: Grace said yes. She sent the 30% deposit (KES 21,600) to your bank account. Mark the job approved and record her bank transfer.
tasks.hint: On the job, '👍 They said yes' → 'Mark approved'. Under BILLING, 'Deposit (30%)' makes the deposit invoice; on it, '💵 Record a payment' — set How to 'Bank transfer'. Never press a 📨 Send button.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bizmgr_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.setup||!d.setup.done||d.setup.demo)return false;var dg=function(s){return String(s||'').replace(/\D/g,'').slice(-9)};var N=function(x){return parseFloat(x)};var ids=(d.customers||[]).filter(function(c){return /grace/i.test(c.name)&&/wambui/i.test(c.name)}).map(function(c){return c.id});var js=(d.jobs||[]).filter(function(j){return ids.indexOf(j.customerId)>=0});return js.some(function(j){if(!j.signed||['approved','scheduled','working','done','closed'].indexOf(j.status)<0)return false;var paid=0;(d.invoices||[]).forEach(function(v){if(v.jobId===j.id)(v.payments||[]).forEach(function(p){if(/bank/i.test(p.method))paid+=N(p.amount)})});return Math.abs(paid-21600)<0.01})}catch(e){return false}})()

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: keeps customers, jobs, quotes and invoices for a small trade business on your phone
prices quotes from your own price list
tracks deposits, payments, expenses and what each job really made
reminds you of to-dos and tax due dates

daily.task: In Business Manager, add one to-do or one expense in shillings for a made-up job — or record an M-Pesa payment with its code on an invoice.

explore.name: 🌱 Welcome
explore.find: It opens here the first time.
explore.try: Tap “Look around with an example business”. Later, come back and try “Set it up for my business (2 min) →” and answer every question.

explore.name: 🏠 Today
explore.find: Tap “Today” in the bar at the bottom.
explore.try: Tap each money box. Tap every “Needs you” card. Tap ➕ New job, 📝 To-do, ⛽ Expense, ⏱ Clock in, then Clock out. Tap “See the whole schedule”.

explore.name: 🧰 Jobs and customers
explore.find: Tap “Jobs” in the bar at the bottom.
explore.try: Search a name. Tap Jobs, Customers and Schedule at the top. Tap ➕ New customer, fill every box, save it, ✏️ Edit it, then delete it.

explore.name: 🧾 One job: the price
explore.find: On Jobs, tap any job card.
explore.try: Tap ⚡ Draft from my price list, ➕ Add item, ⭐ Offer 3 options, 👀 Preview, 🖨️ Print, 👍 They said yes. Look at “📨 Send estimate”, don’t send.

explore.name: 🚚 One job: the rest
explore.find: On the same job, scroll down.
explore.try: Change the date and time. Tap 📅 Add to my calendar, ➕ Type a cost, ➕ Log hours. Write in Notes. Look at the update buttons like 🚚 On my way, don’t send.

explore.name: 💵 An invoice
explore.find: In a job, under Billing, tap “Make the invoice”.
explore.try: Change the dates. Tap 💵 Record a payment, pick M-Pesa, type a code like SJK4XY12AB and save it. Tap 👀 See what they see — find the M-Pesa Till — and 🧰 The job. Look at “📨 Send invoice with M-Pesa details”, don’t send.

explore.name: ➕ New
explore.find: Tap the round “+ New” in the middle of the bottom bar.
explore.try: Open each line: New job, New customer, To-do or reminder, Receipt, Quick expense, Import a bank or card statement. Fill one, save it, then delete it.

explore.name: 📊 Money
explore.find: Tap “Money” in the bar at the bottom.
explore.try: Tap This month, Last month, This year, Last year, All. Tap 📸 Receipt, ➕ Expense, 📋 All expenses, 🗂️ Receipts, 📦 For my accountant, ⏱ Hours for payroll.

explore.name: ⚙️ More
explore.find: Tap “More” in the bar at the bottom.
explore.try: Open Business info (KRA PIN, VAT), Getting paid (M-Pesa Till, Paybill, bank), Price list, Crew, Messages. In “To-do & due dates” tap “Add common due dates” and look at the KRA dates. Tap 💾 Back up. Leave “Erase everything and start over” for last.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open each line: text size (Aa), Ask an AI, More from Daraja, Which AI do you use, 🎬 Take the tour again, Help. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” for the very end.
